KPC INUKA SCHOLARSHIP APPLICATION FOR FORM ONE 2023

Kenya Pipeline Company (KPC), through its philanthropic arm KPC Foundation has since
2016 empowered Children who are differently abled otherwise referred to as People With
Disabilities (PWDs) to access quality secondary school education through the INUKA
Scholarship program. Through the program the company sponsors two students, a boy
and girl joining form one to form four from each of the 47 counties. The scholarship
caters for tuition fees and other personal needs.

KPC in conjunction with the National Council for Persons With Disability (NCPWD) hereby
invite applications from suitably eligible candidates who sat for KCPE in 2022.

Applicants MUST meet the following requirements:

Be a Kenyan citizen

Have sat KCPE in the year 2022

Minimum score 250 marks

Be registered with NCPWD as a Person With Disability
Be a needy student or from a disadvantaged background

The Scholarship application forms are available on the KPC website (www.kpc.co.ke),
the NCPWD website (www.ncpwd.go.ke) and at all County Disability Services Offices
countrywide,

Send your application form and supporting documents to your respective County
Disability Services Office or NCPWD offices in Nairobi by Friday 27* January, 2023.
Only successful candidates will be contacted.

For more information, call +254 (020) 2606500-4 Ext 336 or 334. You may also send
an email to fom@kpc.co.ke.
